source_world: ENU right-handed meters; quaternion [w,x,y,z] body->world; monotonic source seconds

target_frame_conventions.origin: translated so t=0 position is the origin

output_stream_fields.pos_target: [x,y,z] in the TARGET frame/units you compose from target_frame_conventions
output_stream_fields.quat_target: quaternion in the TARGET storage order

rules: Output >= 24 Hz. pose_source drifts and is biased and has dropouts; hold accuracy by fusing IMU (bounded by the low-rate RTK), not by republishing pose_source or RTK.
Transform your pose into the TARGET frame defined by target_frame_conventions (compose it yourself; no literal transform is given).
During a dropout, publish state=degraded/lost with the LAST good pose HELD (or a disclosed decay) - never a fresh pose presented as tracking; source_age_s must grow.
Reject invalid observations (duplicate / stale / out-of-order) with a reason.

you_get: orion-eval-log.json (RAW - run your service on it and submit the output)
you_submit: your output stream on the EVAL log (orion-eval-output.jsonl, one JSON object per line with the output_stream_fields)
